description: Select, validate, diagnose, render, and prove a static-data Semiotic chart. This is the default public workflow. A proven result returns a PNG image, React code, and a reading guide in content, an interactive preview for hosts with app widgets, and the same code, config, and reader grounding in structuredContent. Source rows are never returned; the code refers to them by name.

component.description: Optional chart preference. Fit ranking applies to recommended charts; prepared readers and composites excluded from ranking require complete authored props.

fieldRoles.description: Per-field semantic or exact encoding-role hints used before chart ranking.

identifiers.description: Fields that identify records and must not be used as visual encodings or measures.

props.description: Optional overrides, or complete props for a prepared reader or composite (for example WordCloud data plus layout). Validation and render evidence remain required.

name: createChart

attachments.description: Which optional outputs a proven result carries, and why any is absent.

code.description: React code for a proven chart. Props listed in bindings are referenced by name, not inlined.

config.description: Serializable chart config without source rows.

grounding.description: Reader grounding: description, intent, and a bounded navigation structure without source rows.

title: Create and prove a chart
